name: Converzo Occasions voor Doorlinken Voorraad
author: Converzo

sections.description:
This plugin exists for one purpose: connecting a car dealer’s WordPress site to the Doorlinken Voorraad (DV) service at doorlinkenvoorraad.nl (VWE/Hexon).

It registers an occasions custom post type and receives every stock mutation — add, change, delete — in real time from that coupling, so the inventory on the site always matches the dealer’s own stock administration.

Without an active DV coupling there is no inventory to show. See the FAQ below.

This plugin is made by Converzo. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by VWE, Hexon or Doorlinken Voorraad; those names are used only to describe which service the plugin connects to.

Features

  • Real-time push coupling. The service sends each mutation as a single <voertuig actie="add|change|delete"> document to a protected REST endpoint on your site, secured with HTTP Basic Auth.
  • Listing page with server-side filters: make, model, fuel, transmission, price range and sorting.
  • Optional passenger car / commercial vehicle switch above the listing filters (“All vehicles / Personenauto’s / Bedrijfswagens”). Off by default, and only shown when commercial vehicles are actually in stock.
  • Detail page per vehicle: photo gallery, specifications, description, options and a contact block with your company details.
  • Photo lightbox. Clicking the main photo or any thumbnail opens that photo full screen, with previous/next arrows, keyboard navigation (arrow keys, Esc) and swiping on mobile.
  • Sticky info panel. On desktop the panel with price, specifications and call-to-action buttons stays in view while visitors scroll through the description and options.
  • Colours that match your site. Keep the plugin’s default colours, let the plugin follow your theme’s primary colour automatically (block themes, Elementor, Astra, Kadence, GeneratePress), or pick your own.
  • Configurable company details — name, address, phone, e-mail and contact URL, from the settings screen.
  • Safe by design. An empty or failed feed never removes existing stock. The incremental coupling never performs a “trash missing” sync.
  • Per-vehicle lock. Mark a vehicle as “do not overwrite” and the feed leaves your manual edits alone.
  • Optional bulk import from a DV XML feed URL.
  • Renders inside the active theme, using get_header() and get_footer().

Pro

A paid Pro version, sold separately through Freemius, adds features aimed at turning visitors into leads. Nothing described above depends on it, and nothing in this free version is locked.

  • Lead forms on the vehicle page: request a test drive, ask for a trade-in offer (with a licence plate check) or ask a question. Requests are stored in the dashboard, mailed to the dealer and can be posted to a CRM webhook.
  • WhatsApp button with the vehicle already in the message.
  • Search alerts and price alerts: visitors leave their e-mail address and are notified when a matching vehicle comes in or the price of a vehicle drops. Double opt-in, with an unsubscribe link in every mail.
  • Blocks and shortcodes to show vehicles (grid or carousel) and a search form anywhere on the site.

External services

This plugin communicates with the “Doorlinken Voorraad” service operated by VWE/Hexon at doorlinkenvoorraad.nl. That service sends stock mutations to an endpoint on your site, and vehicle images are served from the media URLs it supplies in the feed. No data is sent to the plugin author.

The service is governed by the agreement between your dealership and VWE/Hexon. See https://www.doorlinkenvoorraad.nl/ for their terms.

The free version contacts no other service. The Pro version additionally:

  • looks up the licence plate a visitor enters on the trade-in form in the open data of the RDW, the Dutch vehicle authority (https://opendata.rdw.nl/). Only the licence plate is sent, from your server; see https://www.rdw.nl/privacy.
  • links to WhatsApp (https://wa.me/) when you configure a WhatsApp number. Nothing is sent until a visitor clicks that button; see https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/.
  • posts each lead to the webhook URL you enter, if you enter one.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the zip through Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate Converzo Occasions voor Doorlinken Voorraad from the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to Occasions → Instellingen and fill in your company details on the Algemeen tab.
  4. On that same screen, note the endpoint URL and the Basic Auth credentials, and enter them in the doorlinkenvoorraad.nl portal (incremental method).
  5. The service then populates your inventory automatically. The listing lives at /occasions/.
  6. Optional: adjust colours, the sticky panel offset and the vehicle type switch on the Weergave tab.
sections.faq:
Do I need a coupling from doorlinkenvoorraad.nl?

Yes. The plugin is built specifically for the “Doorlinken Voorraad” (DV) incremental coupling and receives its inventory from it. Your dealership requests this coupling through doorlinkenvoorraad.nl (VWE/Hexon).

Will my inventory be deleted if the feed fails?

No. An empty or failed feed leaves existing stock untouched. Only an explicit delete mutation removes a vehicle.

Can I edit vehicle details by hand?

Yes, but the next push overwrites them unless you tick “do not overwrite by the feed” on that vehicle.

Can the plugin match my site’s colours?

Yes. Under Occasions → Instellingen → Weergave, choose “Huisstijl van het thema volgen” to take over your theme’s primary colour automatically, or “Eigen kleuren” to pick the colours yourself. For anything beyond colours, add CSS through WordPress itself (Appearance → Customize → Additional CSS, or the Site Editor’s Styles). All plugin markup is scoped under .vwe-occasions.

The sticky info panel disappears behind my theme’s header.

Increase “Afstand sticky zijbalk tot bovenkant” on the Weergave tab to the height of your header plus a little space.

What do I enter under “URL-vorm op eigen website” in the portal?

Copy the value shown as “URL-vorm op eigen website” under Occasions → Instellingen. It looks like https://www.example.com/occasions/?cvzo_id=[voertuignr_hexon]. The service replaces [voertuignr_hexon] with the vehicle number, and the plugin redirects visitors to the detail page of that vehicle. If the vehicle is no longer in stock they land on the listing instead.

How do I show separate passenger car and commercial vehicle listings?

Enable “Filter op voertuigsoort” on the Weergave tab. The switch appears above the listing filters as soon as commercial vehicles are in stock. Each option has its own URL (/occasions/?cvzo_soort=personen and /occasions/?cvzo_soort=bedrijf), so you can link to it from your menu.
sections.changelog:
1.10.5

  • New: option on the “Weergave” tab to add the licence plate to the title tag of the vehicle detail page. Works with the core title and with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress and All in One SEO. Off by default.

1.10.4

  • New: try Pro free for 30 days, without payment details. The offer is on the “Pro” tab and in a notice in the dashboard.
  • The button on the “Pro” tab is now called “Pro bestellen”: it opens the checkout, not a price list.

1.10.3

  • Upgrading now offers iDEAL: the button on the “Pro” tab opens the hosted checkout directly. The licence key arrives by e-mail and is entered in WordPress; it is no longer activated automatically.

1.10.2

  • Fixed: the upgrade button led back to the settings screen instead of the hosted checkout.

1.10.1

  • Fixed: the button on the “Pro” tab now opens the hosted checkout directly, in Dutch for Dutch-language sites, so iDEAL is available. The English pricing page inside wp-admin is skipped.

1.10.0

  • Pro: lead forms on the vehicle page (test drive, trade-in offer with licence plate check, question), with a lead overview in the dashboard, e-mail notification and an optional CRM webhook.
  • Pro: WhatsApp button on the vehicle page.
  • Pro: search alerts and price alerts by e-mail, with double opt-in and an unsubscribe link.
  • Pro: blocks “Occasions” and “Occasions zoeken”, and the shortcodes [cvzo_occasions] and [cvzo_occasions_zoeken].
  • New for developers: hooks in the templates and the importer (cvzo_occasions_cta_row, cvzo_occasions_after_price, cvzo_occasions_after_detail, cvzo_occasions_after_filters, cvzo_occasions_archive_notices, cvzo_occasions_vehicle_saved, cvzo_occasions_settings_tabs).
  • New: a “Pro” tab on the settings screen describes what the Pro version adds. It is the only place the plugin mentions it.
  • The free version itself is unchanged for visitors.

1.9.1

  • New: choose where the “Verkocht” / “Gereserveerd” label sits on the photo: top left, top right, bottom left or bottom right (Weergave).

1.9.0

  • New: action prices. When the feed carries an actieprijs below the regular price, the listing and detail page show the old price struck through next to the action price. Filtering and sorting use the action price.
  • New: “Verkocht” and “Gereserveerd” labels on the vehicle photos in the listing and on the detail page, from the verkocht and gereserveerd fields in the feed.
  • New: under Weergave you choose the label’s colours with a colour picker and its shape on the photo: badge, bar, corner ribbon, stamp or full overlay.
  • New: the address of a vehicle that is no longer in stock redirects to the listing, with a short notice, instead of showing a “page not found” error.
  • Both new price and status fields can be edited by hand in the “Voertuiggegevens” box.
  • Note: vehicles already on the site pick up their action price and status at their next push. Use “alles opnieuw versturen” in the portal to refresh everything at once.

1.8.0

  • New: fixed URL per vehicle number for the portal setting “URL-vorm op eigen website”. /occasions/?cvzo_id=[voertuignr_hexon] redirects to the detail page of that vehicle; the exact value to copy is shown under Occasions → Instellingen. A vehicle that is no longer in stock leads to the listing. Other parameters on the link (such as utm_source) are kept.

1.7.1

  • Updated Freemius SDK to the latest version.
  • Security: the push endpoint no longer writes anything to the database before a request has authenticated. Unauthenticated requests can no longer fill the options table or replace the “last payload” shown on the settings screen.

1.7.0

  • All code, options and vehicle data now use the cvzo prefix. Existing settings, push credentials and vehicles are migrated on update.
  • The push endpoint is now /wp-json/cvzo-occasions/v1/dv. The previous URL keeps working, so the Hexon portal does not need to be changed.
  • Old listing filter links such as ?vwe_soort=bedrijf redirect to their new form.
  • Incoming Basic Auth credentials are sanitized before use.

1.6.0

  • Renamed the plugin to “Converzo Occasions voor Doorlinken Voorraad”.
  • Removed the “Eigen CSS” tab. CSS saved there is moved to the theme’s Additional CSS on update, so it keeps working.
  • The internal post type key is now cvzo_occasion. Existing vehicles and menu links are migrated on update; the /occasions/ URLs do not change.
  • Admin styles and scripts are now loaded as proper enqueued files.

1.5.1

  • Fixed: the “Weergave” and “Eigen CSS” tabs on the settings screen opened the Occasions overview instead of the tab.

1.5.0

  • New: photo lightbox on the detail page with previous/next arrows, keyboard navigation and swipe. Clicking a thumbnail opens that photo.
  • New: the price/specifications panel on the detail page is sticky on desktop. Description and options now sit in the left column beside it.
  • New: settings screen split into tabs: Algemeen, Weergave and Eigen CSS.
  • New: colour settings — plugin default, follow the theme’s colours automatically, or custom colours.
  • New: custom CSS tab for developers, with a code editor.
  • New: optional “Personenauto’s / Bedrijfswagens” switch on the listing page, hidden when there are no commercial vehicles in stock.

1.4.0

  • Renamed the plugin to “DoorlinkenVoorraad koppeling”.
  • Readme rewritten in English, as required for the WordPress plugin directory.
  • Added a GPLv2 license file.
  • Escaped previously unescaped output on the listing page.
  • Hardened handling of Basic Auth credentials on the push endpoint.
  • Prepared for distribution through the WordPress plugin directory alongside Freemius.

1.3.1

  • Distribution through Freemius, with automatic updates in the WordPress dashboard.

1.3.0

  • Editable vehicle fields in the admin (“Voertuiggegevens” meta box).
  • Per-vehicle lock: “do not overwrite by the VWE/Hexon feed”.
  • Admin warning when editing fields that the next push would overwrite.

1.2.0

  • Decoupled from a specific theme: now renders in any WordPress theme through get_header()/get_footer().
  • Company details (name, address, phone, e-mail, contact URL) configurable from the settings screen.
  • Theme-independent, self-contained stylesheet.
  • Freemius SDK integration for licensing and updates.

1.1.4

  • Styling and display improvements on the detail page.

1.1.0

  • Real-time incremental DV push coupling (REST endpoint).
